name: Brianan
text: Brianan is the name of a divinity the Scottish Gaelic people call out in their cries. They could ask him for good fortune or for evil upon another. More often they wanted him to bring misfortune and grief upon their enemies. Sometimes the people gave him the extra name Brianan Buidhe, which means the Yellow. He has no fixed home or family in the tales, only a wry role in speech.

attributes.attribute: an unnamed divinity of Scottish Gaelic

okr.objective: Describe the slight-known Gaelic divinity Brianan.
key_results: Brianan is a divine name used in Scottish Gaelic cries.
He could be asked for good or ill.
He mostly brings misfortune to enemies.
Sometimes he is called Brianan Buidhe.
